note: What a server sends to tell a client something happened. The sort is named first and settles what follows; unlike WorldEvent it carries no source apart from what the sort itself carries.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What sort of thing happened, and so which shape follows. Only a turret dying has been observed, and what follows any other sort is not recorded here.

fields.name: credited
fields.note: The unit the death is credited to.

fields.name: gold
fields.note: Gold given for the death. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: assistCount
fields.note: How many of the places below carry a unit. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: assists
fields.note: The units that helped, twelve places. Zero in everything observed.
